questions.question: The teacher said to the student, 'Put your phone away now.' What did the teacher tell the student?
options: to play with his phone
to put his phone away
to turn off his phone
to use his phone during class

questions.question: The new policy has reduced the company's carbon footprint.
options: The new policy is being implemented
The new policy has been implemented
The new policy will be implemented soon
The new policy was implemented last year
questions.answer: The new policy has been implemented

questions.question: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
options: I study hard now
I am studying for another exam
I wish I had studied harder
I will study harder next time
questions.answer: I would have passed the exam

questions.question: The manager was impressed by the team's performance, which had been improving over the past few months.
options: had improved
were improving
is improving
was improving

questions.question: The company is considering investing in a new project, which would create hundreds of jobs.
options: that will create hundreds of jobs
which has created hundreds of jobs
what would create hundreds of jobs
where the jobs are located
questions.answer: which would create hundreds of jobs

questions.question: The tourists got lost in the city because they had not brought a map.
options: because they had not bought a map
as they did not have a map
since they didn't bring a map
for they hadn't brought a map
questions.answer: because they had not brought a map

questions.question: The new restaurant serves delicious food at affordable prices.
options: serves expensive food at low prices
serves cheap food at high prices
is serving food at reasonable prices
has served food at affordable prices
questions.answer: serves delicious food at affordable prices

questions.question: The students were advised to read the chapter carefully before answering the questions.
options: were told to read the chapter quickly
had been asked to read the chapter slowly
are being recommended to read the chapter thoroughly
have been instructed to read the chapter carefully
questions.answer: have been instructed to read the chapter carefully

questions.question: The city's population has increased significantly over the past decade.
options: has grown rapidly
is growing slowly
was increasing steadily
had decreased slightly

questions.question: The manager was unhappy with the team's performance, which had been below expectations.
options: were disappointing
is unsatisfactory
was unacceptable
had been satisfactory
